keyPoints: Newton ke pehle niyam ke anusaar har vastu apni sthiti — sthir ya samaan gati — banaye rakhti hai jab tak uspar bahari bal na lage; ise jadatva (inertia) kehte hain.
Jadatva bhaar par nirbhar karta hai — bhari truck ko dhakelna halki cycle se mushkil hai, aur tez daudti gaadi achanak nahi rukti.
Doosre niyam ke anusaar bal = bhaar × twaran (F = ma); jitna zyada bal lagao, gati me utna tez badlav aata hai.
Teesra niyam kehta hai — har kriya ki barabar aur viprit pratikriya hoti hai; rocket neeche gas nikaalkar upar uthta hai aur tairte samay hum paani ko peeche dhakelte hain.
Gharshan ek virodhi bal hai jo gati ko rokta hai; chikni barf par gharshan kam hota hai isiliye wahaan phislan hoti hai.
Bal ki disha aur parimaan dono hote hain — isi liye ye sadish raashi (vector) hai, jabki chaal adish raashi hai.
Aam galti: kriya-pratikriya ek hi vastu par lagti hain ye manna; ye hamesha do alag vastuon par lagti hain, isiliye ek-dusre ko kaat ti nahi hain.

title: Bal aur Gati ke Niyam
